```scala
package newspipe.application.services

import com.typesafe.scalalogging.LazyLogging
import newspipe.application.ports.*
import newspipe.domain.models.*

import java.time.Instant
import scala.collection.mutable

final class IngestionService(
    rss: RssSource,
    sink: BronzeSink,
    raw: RawPublisher
) extends LazyLogging:
  private val seen = mutable.HashSet.empty[String]

  def runOnce(now: Instant): Int =
    val items = rss.fetch()
    raw.publish(items)
    val fresh = items.filterNot(it => seen(BronzeUnit.idFor(it)))
    if fresh.isEmpty then 0
    else
      val units = fresh.map(it => BronzeUnit.fromRss(it, Enrichment.empty, now))
      val n = sink.write(units)
      units.foreach(u => seen.add(u.id))
      n
```

```scala
package newspipe.infrastructure.env

import com.typesafe.config.{Config, ConfigFactory}

import scala.jdk.CollectionConverters.*

final case class EnvConfig(
    feeds: List[String],
    pollIntervalSeconds: Long,
    kafkaBootstrap: String,
    rawTopic: String,
    bronzePath: String,
    sparkMaster: String
)

object Env:
  def load(): EnvConfig =
    load(ConfigFactory.load().getConfig("newspipe"))

  def load(cfg: Config): EnvConfig =
    EnvConfig(
      feeds = sys.env.get("NEWSPIPE_FEEDS").map(_.split(",").toList.map(_.trim).filter(_.nonEmpty))
        .getOrElse(cfg.getStringList("feeds").asScala.toList),
      pollIntervalSeconds = sys.env.get("NEWSPIPE_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS").map(_.toLong)
        .getOrElse(cfg.getLong("poll-interval-seconds")),
      kafkaBootstrap = sys.env.get("NEWSPIPE_KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP")
        .getOrElse(cfg.getString("kafka.bootstrap-servers")),
      rawTopic = sys.env.get("NEWSPIPE_RAW_TOPIC")
        .getOrElse(cfg.getString("kafka.raw-topic")),
      bronzePath = sys.env.get("NEWSPIPE_BRONZE_PATH")
        .getOrElse(cfg.getString("bronze.path")),
      sparkMaster = sys.env.get("NEWSPIPE_SPARK_MASTER")
        .getOrElse(cfg.getString("spark.master"))
    )
```

```scala
package newspipe.control.dependencyInjection

import newspipe.application.services.IngestionService
import newspipe.infrastructure.bronze.DeltaBronzeSink
import newspipe.infrastructure.env.EnvConfig
import newspipe.infrastructure.messagequeue.KafkaRawPublisher
import newspipe.infrastructure.rss.RomeRssClient
import org.apache.spark.sql.SparkSession

final class AppContainer(env: EnvConfig):
  val spark: SparkSession = SparkSession.builder()
    .appName("newspipe-ingestion")
    .master(env.sparkMaster)
    .config("spark.sql.extensions", "io.delta.sql.DeltaSparkSessionExtension")
    .config("spark.sql.catalog.spark_catalog", "org.apache.spark.sql.delta.catalog.DeltaCatalog")
    .getOrCreate()
  val rss = new RomeRssClient(env.feeds)
  val sink = new DeltaBronzeSink(spark, env.bronzePath)
  val raw = new KafkaRawPublisher(env.kafkaBootstrap, env.rawTopic)
  val service = new IngestionService(rss, sink, raw)

  def close(): Unit =
    raw.close()
    spark.stop()
```

```scala
package newspipe.control.entryPoint

import com.typesafe.scalalogging.LazyLogging
import newspipe.control.dependencyInjection.AppContainer
import newspipe.infrastructure.env.Env

import java.time.{Duration, Instant}

object Main extends LazyLogging:
  def main(args: Array[String]): Unit =
    val env = Env.load()
    val app = new AppContainer(env)
    sys.addShutdownHook { app.close() }
    val poll = Duration.ofSeconds(env.pollIntervalSeconds)
    logger.info(s"newspipe-ingestion polling ${env.feeds.size} feeds every $poll")
    while true do
      try
        val n = app.service.runOnce(Instant.now())
        logger.info(s"poll wrote $n bronze units")
      catch case e: Exception => logger.error("poll iteration failed", e)
      Thread.sleep(poll.toMillis)
```

```scala
package newspipe

import newspipe.application.ports.*
import newspipe.application.services.IngestionService
import newspipe.domain.models.*
import org.scalatest.funspec.AnyFunSpec
import org.scalatest.matchers.should.Matchers

import java.time.Instant

class IngestionServiceSpec extends AnyFunSpec with Matchers:
  private def item(g: String) = RssItem(g, "https://feed/x", s"T$g", s"https://a/$g", None, "Body")

  describe("IngestionService.runOnce") {
    it("publishes raw and writes raw-only bronze rows, dedups second run") {
      var published: List[RssItem] = Nil
      var written: List[BronzeUnit] = Nil
      val svc = new IngestionService(
        new RssSource:
          def fetch(): List[RssItem] = List(item("g1"), item("g2")),
        new BronzeSink:
          def write(units: List[BronzeUnit]): Int =
            written = units
            units.size,
        new RawPublisher:
          def publish(items: List[RssItem]): Unit = published = items
      )
      val now = Instant.parse("2026-10-10T10:00:00Z")
      svc.runOnce(now) shouldBe 2
      published.map(_.guid) shouldBe List("g1", "g2")
      written.map(_.summary) shouldBe List("", "")
      svc.runOnce(now) shouldBe 0
    }
    it("retries the batch after a sink failure instead of losing it") {
      var calls = 0
      var written: List[BronzeUnit] = Nil
      val svc = new IngestionService(
        new RssSource:
          def fetch(): List[RssItem] = List(item("g1")),
        new BronzeSink:
          def write(units: List[BronzeUnit]): Int =
            calls += 1
            if calls == 1 then throw new RuntimeException("sink down")
            else
              written = units
              units.size,
        new RawPublisher:
          def publish(items: List[RssItem]): Unit = ()
      )
      val now = Instant.parse("2026-10-10T10:00:00Z")
      an[RuntimeException] should be thrownBy svc.runOnce(now)
      svc.runOnce(now) shouldBe 1
      written.map(_.id) shouldBe List(BronzeUnit.idFor(item("g1")))
      svc.runOnce(now) shouldBe 0
    }
  }
```

```scala
package newspipe.infrastructure.kafka

import io.circe.Decoder
import io.circe.generic.semiauto.deriveDecoder
import io.circe.parser.*
import newspipe.application.ports.RawConsumer
import newspipe.domain.models.RssItem
import org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.KafkaConsumer
import org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.StringDeserializer

import java.time.{Duration, Instant}
import java.util.Properties
import scala.jdk.CollectionConverters.*

object KafkaConsumerCodecs:
  given Decoder[Instant] = Decoder.decodeString.map(Instant.parse)
  given Decoder[RssItem] = deriveDecoder[RssItem]

final class KafkaRawConsumer(bootstrapServers: String, topic: String, groupId: String) extends RawConsumer with AutoCloseable:
  private val consumer = new KafkaConsumer[String, String](KafkaRawConsumer.props(bootstrapServers, groupId))
  consumer.subscribe(java.util.List.of(topic))

  def poll(): List[RssItem] =
    import KafkaConsumerCodecs.given
    consumer.poll(Duration.ofSeconds(10)).asScala.toList.flatMap { rec =>
      parse(rec.value()).toOption.flatMap(_.as[RssItem].toOption)
    }

  def commit(): Unit = consumer.commitSync()

  def close(): Unit = consumer.close()

object KafkaRawConsumer:
  def props(bootstrapServers: String, groupId: String): Properties =
    val p = new Properties()
    p.put("bootstrap.servers", bootstrapServers)
    p.put("group.id", groupId)
    p.put("key.deserializer", classOf[StringDeserializer].getName)
    p.put("value.deserializer", classOf[StringDeserializer].getName)
    p.put("enable.auto.commit", "false")
    p.put("auto.offset.reset", "earliest")
    p
```

```scala
package newspipe.infrastructure.bronze

import newspipe.application.ports.BronzeMergeSink
import newspipe.domain.models.BronzeUnit
import org.apache.spark.sql.SparkSession

final class DeltaMergeSink(spark: SparkSession, bronzePath: String) extends BronzeMergeSink:

  def merge(units: List[BronzeUnit]): Int =
    if units.isEmpty then 0
    else
      import spark.implicits.*
      val updates = units.map { u =>
        (u.id, u.summary, u.countries.toArray, u.geoArea.value, u.topics.toArray, u.actors.toArray, u.urgency.value, u.language)
      }.toDF("id", "summary", "countries", "geo_area", "topics", "actors", "urgency", "language")
      updates.createOrReplaceTempView("updates")
      spark.sql(s"""MERGE INTO delta.`$bronzePath` AS bronze USING updates ON bronze.id = updates.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET bronze.summary = updates.summary, bronze.countries = updates.countries, bronze.geo_area = updates.geo_area, bronze.topics = updates.topics, bronze.actors = updates.actors, bronze.urgency = updates.urgency, bronze.language = updates.language""").count()
      units.size
```

```scala
package newspipe.application.services

import com.typesafe.scalalogging.LazyLogging
import newspipe.application.ports.{BronzeMergeSink, EnrichmentPort, RawConsumer}
import newspipe.domain.models.BronzeUnit
import java.time.Instant

final class EnrichmentService(
    consumer: RawConsumer,
    enrich: EnrichmentPort,
    sink: BronzeMergeSink
) extends LazyLogging:
  def runOnce(now: Instant): Int =
    val items = consumer.poll()
    val merged = items.flatMap { it =>
      enrich.enrich(it) match
        case Right(en) => Some(BronzeUnit.fromRss(it, en, now))
        case Left(err) =>
          logger.warn(s"enrichment failed for ${it.link}: ${err.getMessage}; leaving unenriched")
          None
    }
    val n = sink.merge(merged)
    consumer.commit()
    n
```
